# Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust & Shri Narayandas Rastogi Educational Institutions, Kiratpur (Bijnor, U.P.) — Comprehensive Institutional Dossier

## 1. Executive Overview
**Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust** (श्री नारायण दास रस्तोगी चैरिटेबल ट्रस्ट (पंजी.)) is an irrevocable Indian public charitable trust established on **09 August 1991** in New Delhi (Registered with the Office of the Sub-Registrar, Delhi vide Registration Nos. **3315 & 1812** dated `09.08.1991`) in sacred memory of **Late Lala Narain Dass Rastogi** by his descendants led by **Late Shri Ram Bahadur Gupta (R.B. Gupta / Ram Bahadur Rastogi)**, **Late Shri Raj Bahadur Rastogi**, and **Late Shri Satish Chandra Rastogi** (sons of Late Shri Badri Parshad).

Guided by its foundational Sanskrit and Hindi mottos — **"सेवा ही जीवन है / नर सेवा ही जीवन है"** (*Service is Life / Service to Mankind is Life*), **"शिक्षा एवम् स्वास्थ्य — अहिंसा सेवा में"** (*Education and Health in Non-Violent Service*), and the school motto **"तमसो मा ज्योतिर्गमय"** (*Lead me from darkness to light*) — the Trust has dedicated over **35 years** to running self-reliant educational institutions and rural welfare programs in **Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur, District Bijnor, Uttar Pradesh (PIN 246731)**.

Remarkably, since its inception in 1991, the Trust and its educational wing (**Shri Narayandas Rastogi Aadarsh Shiksha Samiti**) have operated the Kiratpur schools **100% through family endowments and philanthropic contributions without taking government grants**, providing free education to economically weaker sections (EWS), SC/ST/OBC children, and rural girls, and charging only nominal fees to others.

---

## 2. Three Educational Wings at the Kiratpur Campus (District Bijnor, U.P.)
Built upon the ancestral property donated by the settlors in **Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur – 246731, District Bijnor (U.P.)**, the campus comprises three recognized educational wings:

1. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Saraswati Shishu Mandir (श्री नारायण दास रस्तोगी सरस्वती शिशु मन्दिर — Primary Wing, Nursery to Class V):**
   - **Recognition:** Granted **Permanent Recognition (स्थाई मान्यता)** by the District Basic Education Officer (*Zila Basic Shiksha Adhikari*), Bijnor vide **Order No. `891/96-97` dated `31.05.1997`** (signed by Shri S.P. Singh Tyagi), effective from July 1996.
   - **Focus:** Co-educational foundational literacy, numeracy, moral values (*Sanskar*), and primary education following the Uttar Pradesh Basic Shiksha Parishad curriculum.

2. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Junior High School (श्री नारायण दास रस्तोगी बालिका विद्या मन्दिर जूनियर हाई स्कूल — Upper Primary Girls' Wing, Classes VI to VIII):**
   - **Recognition:** Granted **Upper Primary Recognition (मान्यता कक्षा 6 से 8)** by the District Basic Education Officer, Bijnor vide **Order No. `Shiksha/Manyata/5691-92/2000-01` dated `25.02.2002`** (signed by Shri Manohar Lal), with sanctioned posts for 1 Headmaster, 4 Assistant Teachers (Language, Science/Math, Craft), 1 Clerk, and 2 Support Staff.
   - **Focus:** Empowering adolescent girls in semi-urban and rural Bijnor with middle-school academics, science, home science, and vocational crafts.

3. **Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Inter College (श्री नारायणदास रस्तोगी बालिका विद्या मन्दिर इण्टर कॉलेज — Secondary / High School & Inter College Wing, Classes IX to XII):**
   - **Recognition:** Granted **UP Board High School Recognition (नवीन मान्यता — हाई स्कूल परीक्षा)** by the Regional Secretary, **Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, Uttar Pradesh (Bareilly Region)** vide **Order No. `मा०शि०प०/ब/मान्यता 2097-2101` dated `26.10.2004`** (pursuant to U.P. Government Order No. `4473/15-7-04-4(39)/2003` dated `27.09.2004`).
   - **Focus:** Secondary and higher secondary education for girls in Kiratpur and surrounding villages of Bijnor district, preventing drop-outs after Class 8 and preparing young women for higher education and careers.

---

## 3. Chronological Heritage Timeline (1991 – 2026 & Vision 2030)
- **09 August 1991 — Founding of the Trust:** Late Shri Ram Bahadur Gupta (R.B. Gupta), along with his brothers Shri Raj Bahadur Rastogi and Shri Satish Chandra Rastogi (sons of Late Shri Badri Parshad), execute and register the Trust Deed of *Narain Dass Rastogi Charitable Trust* with the Sub-Registrar, Delhi (Reg. No. `3315 & 1812` dated `09.08.1991`). Founding Trustees include Smt. Shakuntala Devi, Shri Ravinder Kumar Rastogi, Shri Suresh Rastogi, and Shri Manoj Rastogi.
- **04 October 1993 — Institutional Certification of the Kiratpur School:** The Trust formally certifies that *Shri Narain Dass Rastogi Saraswati Shishu Mandir* at Mohalla Jhanda, Kiratpur (Bijnor) is functioning on the ancestral property of the Trust settlors, providing free education to poor students, with annual medical checkup camps and drinking water facilities for students and villagers.
- **23 May 1994 — Income Tax Section 12A Registration:** Director of Income Tax (Exemptions), New Delhi grants Registration No. `51/94-95` u/s 12A(a) of the Income Tax Act, 1961 (effective from `09.08.1991`).
- **31 May 1997 — Permanent Primary Recognition (Classes 1–5):** Zila Basic Shiksha Adhikari, Bijnor grants Permanent Recognition (`स्थाई मान्यता`) to *Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Saraswati Shishu Mandir, Kiratpur* vide Order No. `891/96-97`.
- **15 July 1998 — Income Tax Section 80G Exemption:** Director of Income Tax (Exemptions), New Delhi grants 80G tax-exemption approval (`No. DIT(E)/98-99/N-334/91/302`).
- **31 May 1999 — MHA FCRA Registration:** Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India registers the Trust under Section 6(1) of the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act, 1976 (`Reg. No. 231650986`, Ref `II/21022/83(86)/98-FCRA.III`) as an Educational & Social charitable institution.
- **25 February 2002 — Upper Primary Recognition (Classes 6–8):** Zila Basic Shiksha Adhikari, Bijnor grants recognition to *Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir Junior High School, Kiratpur* vide Order No. `Shiksha/Manyata/5691-92/2000-01`.
- **26 October 2004 — UP Board High School Recognition:** Madhyamik Shiksha Parishad, U.P. (Regional Office Bareilly) grants High School examination recognition to *Shri Narayan Das Rastogi Balika Vidya Mandir, Kiratpur, Bijnor* vide Order No. `मा०शि०प०/ब/मान्यता 2097-2101` (UP Govt. Order `4473/15-7-04-4(39)/2003`).
- **May 2026 — Reconstitution of School Management Committee & Clean Water Project:** The 12-member School Management Committee (*Vidyalaya Prabandh Samiti*) is updated under Chairman **Shri Subhash Rastogi** and Manager **Shri Vipul Kumar Rastogi**. Principal **Shri Devendra Singh** initiates the **260-foot deep submersible borewell & municipal pipeline clean drinking water project** to replace the aging 120-ft borewell and deliver pure drinking water to students.
- **June 2026 — Reconstitution of Trust Board, Renewed 12AB & 80G Orders, and Digital Revival:** Supplementary Trust Deeds (dated `02.06.2026` & `08.06.2026`) reconstitute the Board of Trustees with **Shri Subhash Rastogi** (Chairman / Managing Trustee), **Shri Ravinder Kumar Rastogi** (Senior Trustee), and **Shri Vipul Kumar Rastogi** (Trustee). Income Tax Department issues renewed **Form 106 Section 12AB Registration (`AAATN1994LE20261`)** and **Section 80G Approval (`AAATN1994LF20261`)** on `25-06-2026` for Tax Years `2026-27 to 2028-29`. Campus IT and computer literacy upgrades are commissioned.
- **July 2026 — Vision 2030 Integrated K–12 Expansion Proposal:** On `10.07.2026`, the Trust submits a comprehensive institutional vision to the Hon'ble Chief Minister of Uttar Pradesh proposing modern Pre-Primary to Class 12 integrated educational campuses in **Bijnor (Kiratpur), Moradabad, and Gautam Budh Nagar (Noida)** with Smart Classrooms, AI & Robotics Labs, Science & Math Labs, Skill Development Centers, Sports Complexes, and Solar-Powered Green Infrastructure.
- **09 September 2026 — MCA CSR-1 Registration & NITI Aayog NGO Darpan:** Ministry of Corporate Affairs approves Form CSR-1 (**CSR Registration No. `CSR00117504`**, SRN `AC5909859`), enabling corporate CSR partnerships across India alongside NITI Aayog NGO Darpan ID **`DL/2026/1118189`**.
